title: Cirrus Vision Jet G2
notice: The procedures are the sim's own checklist for this aircraft, step by step with the list and item each comes from. The guide has not been run on the aircraft and none of its controls is marked verified; the ticks read standard simulation variables that the aircraft may not drive, so a step that never ticks does not mean you did it wrong. What the sim's checklist file does not contain is said where it is named: the ENGINE START BAT TEMP, Alternate Gear Extension and STICK PUSHER FAIL checklists, the climb tables and the VREF table. It has no procedure for Safe Return (the emergency autoland) or for the CAPS parachute.
sources: checklist.xml shipped with the aircraft (Official2024/Steam/microsoft-aircraft-sf50/html_ui/html_ui.fsarchive, airplanes/microsoft_sf50/checklist): the sim's own interactive checklist (normal, icing, abnormal and emergency procedures, CAS messages)
en-us.locpak of the same package (minimal.fsarchive): the aircraft's English tooltips and the CLUE texts of its checklist
tablet.js in the same html_ui archive: the management tablet (external power, chocks, covers, state presets)

wa_start.title: Before you start
wa_start.text: Make sure all required maintenance has been done, review the flight plan and work out weight and balance and performance. Throughout the walk around, check all hinges, hinge pins and bolts for security, the skin for damage, condition and delamination, all control surfaces for movement and free play, and the area around liquid reservoirs and lines for leaks. Keep equipment and loose material away from the engine exhaust and inlet. Remove every securing device: AOA cover, engine exhaust plugs or cover, probe covers, static port covers, gust locks and any aftermarket equipment. In cold weather remove all frost, ice, snow and slush from the fuselage, wing, stabilizers, control surfaces and engine inlet, and check that the wheels are free of snow and ice. The checklist warns that failing to do so may result in significant damage, loss of the aircraft and loss of life.

ic_ips_air.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, in flight"

steps.text: Set PROBE HEAT to ON.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, in flight", item 1

steps.text: Set ENGINE IPS to ON.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, in flight", item 2

steps.text: Set WING/STAB IPS to OFF.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, in flight", item 3

steps.text: Set WINDSHLD IPS to OFF.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, in flight", item 4

ic_ips_gnd.title: On the ground
ic_ips_gnd.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, on the ground"

steps.text: Set PROBE HEAT to ON.
steps.warn: Above 41 °F (5 °C) the probe heat may be on for only 5 minutes in a row on the ground. Longer use in warmer temperatures may damage the composite structure next to the pitot probe.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, on the ground", item 1

steps.text: Set ENGINE IPS to ON.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "OAT 41 °F (5 °C) or less with visible moisture or visibility under 1 mile, on the ground", item 2

ic_ips_ice.title: At the first sign of ice
ic_ips_ice.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "At first sign of ice"

steps.text: Set PROBE HEAT to ON.
steps.warn: Ice on the lifting surfaces may make the stall warning inoperative or inadequate and cause an inadvertent stall and loss of control. WING/STAB IPS must stay ON until the whole wing is free of ice and ice is no longer forming. The stall warning offset must stay ON until the whole airframe is free of ice.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "At first sign of ice", item 1

steps.text: Set ENGINE IPS to ON.
steps.warn: On the ground, for every 10 minutes in falling or blowing snow or any freezing moisture, a static engine run-up to 70% N2 for 30 seconds is required to keep the engine intake, Tt2 probes and Pt2 probes clear of ice. Leave the inlet IPS on for at least 2 minutes before turning it off again.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "At first sign of ice", item 2

steps.text: Set WING/STAB IPS to ON.
steps.why: Verify the STALL SPEED HIGH CAS advisory is shown. In RVSM airspace, contact ATC and notify them of non-RVSM status. The left wing leading edge is the main reference for judging whether ice is building up; ice may also show on the forward windshield.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "At first sign of ice", item 3

steps.text: Set WINDSHLD IPS to ON.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Icing Conditions: IPS Activation", section "At first sign of ice", item 4

ic_done_cond.title: Ice protection set
ic_done_cond.text: If ice starts to form, use the "first sign of ice" steps.

ic_done2.title: Ice protection set
ic_done2.text: Watch the left wing leading edge. Keep WING/STAB IPS ON until the whole wing is free of ice and no more ice is forming.

proc_done.title: Procedure complete
proc_done.text: That is the end of this procedure.

steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL LOW LEFT/RIGHT/TOTAL Warning", item 2

steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL LOW LEFT/RIGHT/TOTAL Warning", item 3

steps.text: Avoid excessive pitch attitudes and sideways acceleration.
steps.why: They can uncover the fuel inlet lines and interrupt the fuel flow.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL LOW LEFT/RIGHT/TOTAL Warning", item 4

steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL PRESSURE LOW Warning", item 1

steps.text: Keep the fuel quantity balanced.

em_press_bad.title: Message stays

steps.text: Climb or descend to warmer conditions.

em_temp_ok.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Warning", section "If in flight, if message extinguishes"

em_valves.title: Both fuel valves failed
em_valves.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVES BOTH FAIL Warning"

steps.text: Check the fuel quantity.
steps.why: Valves that fail together cause a fuel imbalance that grows as the flight goes on. Both valves stay in the last commanded position.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVES BOTH FAIL Warning", item 1

steps.text: Maintain an airspeed that gives adequate roll control.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVES BOTH FAIL Warning", item 2

steps.text: Land as soon as possible.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Emergency CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVES BOTH FAIL Warning", item 3

choices.label: Dry motoring after a failed start

steps.text: Avoid stalls, low airspeed, and uncoordinated or abrupt control inputs.
steps.warn: GIA 1 feeds many systems, so many CAS messages and amber X's appear at once. Treat it as one failure, not many. The clearest sign is the loss of COM1/NAV1 and GPS1 together with several system messages.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 1

steps.text: Select GPS 2 or NAV 2 for navigation.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 2

steps.text: Tune COM 2 and select it as active.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 3

steps.text: Assess and acknowledge the CAS messages.
steps.why: FUEL VALVES BOTH FAIL, PROBE HEAT OFF, IPS WING/STAB FAIL, IPS ENGINE INLET OFF and CABIN PRESSURE CTRL FAIL may come from the loss of monitoring, not from a loss of function, and their procedures are not required for a GIA 1 failure. Other messages may show depending on the configuration (OXYGEN PASSENGER FAIL, FLAPS ICE, FLAPS FAIL, LDG GEAR SELECTOR FAIL, FUEL VALVE AUTO FAIL, STICK PUSHER FAIL, SFD NO COMPARE, STALL SPEED HIGH); they need no action unless a step here says so.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 4

steps.text: Maintain the fuel balance: check the fuel quantity.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 5.a

steps.text: Maintain the fuel balance: set the fuel control switch to the fullest tank.
steps.why: To keep the fuel balanced, watch the fuel quantity and alternate between LEFT and RIGHT as needed.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 5.b

steps.text: Set the altitude as required.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 6

steps.text: Avoid flight into icing conditions.
steps.why: The systems show several FAIL annunciations that come from data loss, not from system failure. If you must go through ice, operate the systems normally. The STALL SPEED HIGH advisory will show, so use the ice-contaminated approach speeds at the current flap setting. FLAPS ICE shows if the flaps were at 100% at the time of the failure.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 7

steps.text: Perform the Alternate Gear Extension checklist.
steps.why: That checklist is not in the sim's checklist file.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 8

steps.text: Press the CABIN PRESSURE DUMP button (below 1500 ft AGL).
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 9

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: GIA 1 Failure", item 10

ab_gps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: Loss of GPS Navigation"

ab_dry.title: Dry motoring
ab_dry.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: Dry Motoring Engine - Failed Engine Start"

steps.text: Set the thrust lever to IDLE.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: Dry Motoring Engine - Failed Engine Start", item 1

steps.text: Set the engine knob to OFF.
steps.why: The engine knob at OFF stops the electric fuel pump.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: Dry Motoring Engine - Failed Engine Start", item 2

steps.text: Set the BLEED switch to FRESH.
steps.why: Heavy bleed air extraction during an engine start gives a hotter ITT and a slower start.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: Dry Motoring Engine - Failed Engine Start", item 3

steps.text: Press and hold the engine button for 15 to 30 seconds.
steps.warn: Battery damage may occur if the motoring goes on too long.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal Procedures: Dry Motoring Engine - Failed Engine Start", item 4

steps.text: Before another start, inspect the engine: no fuel pooled and the exhaust dry.
steps.why: Dry motoring clears residual fuel after a failed start.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Dry Motoring Engine - Failed Engine Start", first note

steps.text: In normal flight with the engine running: land as soon as practicable.
steps.why: The fuel shutoff valve is not in the commanded position.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL SHUTOFF FAIL Caution", section "If during normal flight and engine is running", item a

cf_balanced.title: Fuel tanks balanced
cf_balanced.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TANK BALANCED Advisory"

steps.text: Set the fuel control switch to AUTO.
steps.why: The fuel tank quantities are balanced.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TANK BALANCED Advisory", item 1

cf_temp.title: Fuel temperature low
cf_temp.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution"

steps.text: Check the fuel temperature (L / R).
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", item 1

cf_temp_where.title: In flight or on the ground?

cf_temp_air.title: In flight
cf_temp_air.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", section "If in flight"

steps.text: Climb or descend to warmer conditions.
steps.why: Changing altitude changes the OAT and so the fuel temperature. With a temperature inversion, warmer air may be higher up.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", section "If in flight", item a

steps.text: Monitor the fuel temperature.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", section "If in flight", item a (second)

cf_temp_bad.title: Message stays
cf_temp_bad.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", section "If in flight, if message persists"

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", section "If in flight, if message persists", item (1)

cf_temp_gnd.title: On the ground
cf_temp_gnd.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", section "If on ground"

steps.text: Warm the aircraft to raise the fuel temperature.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL TEMP LOW Caution", section "If on ground", item a

cf_v1.title: Fuel valve 1 failed
cf_v1.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #1 FAIL Caution"

steps.text: Check the fuel quantity.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #1 FAIL Caution", item 1

steps.text: Set the fuel control switch to the fullest tank.
steps.warn: Avoid AUTO: it draws fuel through fuel valve #1, which has failed.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #1 FAIL Caution", item 2

steps.text: Keep the fuel quantity balanced.
steps.why: To keep the fuel balanced, watch the fuel quantity and alternate between LEFT and RIGHT as needed.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #1 FAIL Caution", item 3

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #1 FAIL Caution", item 4

cf_v2.title: Fuel valve 2 failed
cf_v2.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #2 FAIL Caution"

steps.text: Check the fuel quantity.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #2 FAIL Caution", item 1

steps.text: Set the fuel control switch to AUTO.
steps.why: Keep it in AUTO: that draws fuel through fuel valve #1, which works. Avoid LEFT and RIGHT: they turn the electric fuel pump on and draw fuel through fuel valve #2, which has failed.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #2 FAIL Caution", item 2

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: FUEL VALVE #2 FAIL Caution", item 3

co_bleedoff.title: Bleed off
co_bleedoff.text: BLEED OFF means bleed air is switched to OFF/FRESH. Do you want it off?

co_bleedoff_fix.title: Bleed wanted
co_bleedoff_fix.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: BLEED OFF Caution", section "If bleed is not desired OFF"

steps.text: Cycle the BLEED switch to BLEED.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: BLEED OFF Caution", section "If bleed is not desired OFF", item a

steps.text: Verify the message is out.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: BLEED OFF Caution", section "If bleed is not desired OFF", item b

co_bleedoff_p.title: Message stays
co_bleedoff_p.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: BLEED OFF Caution", section "If message persists"

steps.text: Monitor the cabin altitude.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: BLEED OFF Caution", section "If message persists", item (1)

steps.text: Monitor for the CABIN ALTITUDE HIGH warning.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: BLEED OFF Caution", section "If message persists", item (2)

co_lfe.title: Cabin LFE not set
co_lfe.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: CABIN LFE NOT SET Caution"

steps.text: Monitor the cabin altitude.
steps.why: The CPCS controller has failed. If the cabin pressure controller fails, the CPCS keeps the current cabin altitude.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: CABIN LFE NOT SET Caution", item 1

steps.text: Monitor for the CABIN ALTITUDE HIGH warning.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: CABIN LFE NOT SET Caution", item 2

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: CABIN LFE NOT SET Caution", item 3

co_hot.title: ECS bleed hot
co_hot.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED HOT Caution"

steps.text: Turn the cabin temperature knob to FULL COLD.
steps.why: The message shows when the bleed supply temperature reaches 250 °F (121 °C).
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED HOT Caution", item 1

co_hot_p.title: Message stays
co_hot_p.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED HOT Caution", section "If message persists"

steps.text: Select TEMP BACKUP.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED HOT Caution", section "If message persists", item a

steps.text: Verify the message is out.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED HOT Caution", section "If message persists", item b

co_over.title: ECS bleed overheat
co_over.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution"

steps.text: Turn the cabin temperature knob to FULL COLD.
steps.why: The message shows when the bleed supply temperature reaches 270 °F (132 °C).
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", item 1

co_over_p1.title: Message stays
co_over_p1.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists"

steps.text: Select TEMP BACKUP.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists", item a

steps.text: Verify the message is out.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists", item b

co_over_p2.title: Message still stays
co_over_p2.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists, after TEMP BACKUP"

steps.text: Reduce the thrust lever as far as practical.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists, after TEMP BACKUP", item (1)

steps.text: Verify the message is out.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists, after TEMP BACKUP", item (2)

co_over_q3.title: Does it stay, or TCV CONTROL FAIL?
co_over_q3.text: Does the message persist, or is TCV CONTROL FAIL shown?

co_over_p3.title: Message stays
co_over_p3.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists or TCV CONTROL FAIL is displayed"

steps.text: Set the BLEED switch to FRESH.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists or TCV CONTROL FAIL is displayed", item (a)

steps.text: Monitor the cabin altitude.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists or TCV CONTROL FAIL is displayed", item (b)

steps.text: Monitor for the CABIN ALTITUDE HIGH warning.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists or TCV CONTROL FAIL is displayed", item (c)

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS BLEED OVERHEAT Caution", section "If message persists or TCV CONTROL FAIL is displayed", item (d)

co_backup.title: How was TEMP BACKUP engaged?
co_backup.text: Did you engage the temperature backup mode yourself?

choices.label: No, it came on by itself

co_backup_on.title: Engaged on purpose
co_backup_on.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS TEMP BACKUP Caution", section "If TEMP BACKUP mode engaged intentionally"

steps.text: Adjust the cabin temperature knob for comfort.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS TEMP BACKUP Caution", section "If TEMP BACKUP mode engaged intentionally", item a

steps.text: Monitor for the ECS BLEED HOT or ECS BLEED OVERHEAT cautions.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS TEMP BACKUP Caution", section "If TEMP BACKUP mode engaged intentionally", item b

co_backup_off.title: Engaged by itself
co_backup_off.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS TEMP BACKUP Caution", section "If TEMP BACKUP mode engaged unintentionally"

steps.text: Deselect TEMP BACKUP.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS TEMP BACKUP Caution", section "If TEMP BACKUP mode engaged unintentionally", item a

steps.text: Adjust the ECS controls as required.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: ECS TEMP BACKUP Caution", section "If TEMP BACKUP mode engaged unintentionally", item b

co_toff.title: Takeoff thrust
co_toff.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TAKEOFF THRUST Caution"

steps.text: Set the thrust lever to MCT.
steps.why: The 5 minute takeoff thrust limit was exceeded.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TAKEOFF THRUST Caution", item 1

co_tcv.title: TCV control failed
co_tcv.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution"

steps.text: Monitor the cabin temperature.
steps.why: The TCV usually fails open, which gives colder cabin temperatures than normal. If it does not open, the duct air may be hotter than wanted and a DUCT OVERHEAT caution may follow. An ECS BLEED HOT or ECS BLEED OVERHEAT caution may also follow.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", item 1

co_tcv_q.title: Does the message stay?
co_tcv_q.text: Is the message still shown, and is the cabin warmer or colder than acceptable?

choices.label: It stays and the cabin is too warm
It stays and the cabin is too cold

co_tcv_warm.title: Too warm
co_tcv_warm.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", section "If message persists and cabin temperature is warmer than acceptable"

steps.text: Descend below 10,000 ft if practical.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", section "If message persists and cabin temperature is warmer than acceptable", item a

steps.text: Set the BLEED switch to FRESH.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", section "If message persists and cabin temperature is warmer than acceptable", item b

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", section "If message persists and cabin temperature is warmer than acceptable", item c

co_tcv_cold.title: Too cold
co_tcv_cold.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", section "If message persists and cabin temperature is colder than acceptable"

steps.text: Descend to a warmer outside air temperature if practical.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", section "If message persists and cabin temperature is colder than acceptable", item a

steps.text: Land as soon as practicable.
steps.source: checklist.xml: list "Abnormal CAS Procedures: TCV CONTROL FAIL Caution", section "If message persists and cabin temperature is colder than acceptable", item b
